Job Description:
**Role Overview**


We are looking for a highly driven and hands\-on Centre Manager – Telesales to lead the telesales operations at a single location, managing a team of 40 telecallers along with team leaders. The Centre Manager will be responsible for achieving sales targets, improving conversion ratios, and ensuring operational excellence on the floor. The ideal candidate will bring at least 3\+ years of telesales experience, with proven ability to lead teams, drive performance, and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Team \& Floor Management**

* Manage and lead a team of 40 telecallers, including team leaders.
* Conduct daily huddles, set targets, and ensure achievement of sales goals.
* Monitor call quality, sales scripts, and customer interactions.
* Maintain high levels of motivation, discipline, and energy on the floor.

**Sales Execution \& Target Achievement**

* Drive telesales performance to achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Work closely with telecallers to improve pitch delivery, objection handling, and closing techniques.
* Ensure adherence to sales processes and compliance standards.

**Performance Monitoring \& Reporting**

* Track and analyze daily/weekly/monthly KPIs such as call volume, conversion rate, and revenue per telecaller.

**Training \& Development**

* Conduct regular training sessions for telecallers on sales techniques, product knowledge, and customer handling.
* Provide continuous feedback and one\-on\-one coaching. On\-Ground Involvement
* Actively participate in floor activities by monitoring live calls and assisting team members.
* Be a role model by demonstrating strong selling skills and closing deals when required.

**Customer\-Centric Approach**

* Ensure telecallers follow a consultative sales approach, building trust with customers.
* Address escalations promptly and ensure positive customer experiences.

**Key Requirements**

* Experience: Minimum 3\+ years in telesales, with at least 1 year in a team leadership/managerial role.
* Proven ability to manage teams of 30–50 telecallers in a telesales environment.

• Strong people management, coaching, and motivational skills. • Hands\-on and willing to work directly on the floor with the team.


* Good analytical skills; ability to track performance metrics and improve efficiency.
* Proficiency in CRM tools and telesales processes.
* Preferred Industry Experience: Insurance or Fintech. (EdTech experience not preferred.)

* Lead\-to\-conversion ratio.

* Call quality and compliance scores.
* Telecaller productivity and attrition rate.
* Training effectiveness and performance improvements.

3 \- 10 years

Any graduation ,and MBA/PGDM

Telesales , Team Handling , Inside Sales , Sales , Relationship Management , Business Development , BPO , Team Leadership

**Project Role :** Full Stack Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Responsible for developing and/or engineering the end\-to\-end features of a system, from user experience to backend code. Use development skills to deliver innovative solutions that help our clients improve the services they provide. Leverage new technologies that can be applied to solve challenging business problems with a cloud first and agile mindset.
  

**Must have skills :** PHP (Programming Language)  

**Good to have skills :** AWS Architecture, AWS Administration  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Roles and Responsibilities  

Development  

(a) Implement backend and web\-tier features in PHP 8\.x in accordance with agreed technical designs and acceptance criteria.  

(b) Build and consume RESTful APIs for OTT capabilities such as subscriber management, catalogue administration, metadata publishing, and back\-office workflows.  

(c) Develop within the established framework, Laravel or Symfony, and follow its conventions rather than working around them.  

(d) Write typed, statically analysable PHP using declared types, strict types, constructor property promotion, enums, match expressions, and readonly properties where appropriate.  

(e) Develop and maintain integrations with AWS managed services, including S3, SQS, SNS, Lambda, RDS, Aurora, ElastiCache, and Secrets Manager, as part of feature delivery.  

(f) Implement asynchronous and queued workloads correctly, including job design, idempotency, retry and failure handling, and dead\-letter queue management.  

(g) Produce unit and integration tests using PHPUnit or Pest to meet the agreed coverage threshold, and maintain static analysis using PHPStan or Psalm at the agreed level.  

(h) Follow branching, code review, and CI/CD practices, and keep Composer dependencies and security audit findings up to date.  

  

Java Microservices Integration  

* Consume Java/Spring Boot microservice APIs from PHP application code, working to the published OpenAPI or gRPC contract.
* Build and maintain typed client layers and DTO mappings between PHP models and Java service payloads.
* Handle cross\-runtime data correctness, including date and time representation, time zone handling, decimal and monetary precision, 64\-bit integer handling, null and optional semantics, and enum and collection serialization.
* Implement authentication and token propagation across the PHP–Java boundary (OAuth2/JWT, service\-to\-service credentials, correlation ID forwarding).
* Read Java and Spring Boot source sufficiently to trace a contract, locate a controller or DTO, and confirm expected behaviour before raising a defect.
* Implement resilient integration behaviour — timeouts, bounded retries, graceful degradation when a downstream service is unavailable.

  

Application Support (L3\)  

* Triage and fix application defects raised by L1\.5/L2 teams, incident analysis, or other production detection channels.
* Perform root cause analysis on assigned defects within the custom codebase escalate product\-component defects to the product maintenance team with reproducible evidence.
* Isolate whether a cross\-boundary defect originates in the PHP layer, the Java service, or the contract between them — and route it accordingly with evidence rather than by assumption.
* Investigate PHP\-specific production issues — memory limits, execution timeouts, FPM worker saturation, OPcache staleness after deployment, N\+1 query patterns.
* Support release note preparation, non\-prod validation, and production deployment activities including rollback verification.
* Participate in on\-call or shift\-based support rotation as required by the engagement model.

  

Must\-Have Skills  

PHP  

* Three to four years of hands\-on backend development, including at least two years of production experience with PHP 7\.4 or PHP 8\.x.
* Modern PHP practices, including OOP, namespaces, interfaces and traits, dependency injection, type declarations, exception handling, Composer, PSR\-4, and PSR\-12 standards.
* Production experience with Laravel or Symfony, including routing, middleware, service containers, ORM using Eloquent or Doctrine, migrations, queues, and events.
* Testing with PHPUnit or Pest, including mocking of external dependencies.
* Working knowledge of static analysis (PHPStan or Psalm) and coding\-standard tooling.
* Strong SQL and relational data skills — joins, indexing awareness, query performance, migration authoring.

  

AWS  

* Working knowledge of at least four AWS services in a development capacity, typically S3, SQS, SNS, Lambda, RDS, Aurora, ElastiCache, API Gateway, ECS, or Secrets Manager.
* Understanding of how the PHP application is deployed and served, such as nginx or Apache with PHP\-FPM on EC2 or ECS, or serverless PHP, and the associated operational implications.

  

Java Integration  

* Demonstrable experience integrating PHP applications with Java\-based services in production, beyond merely calling a third\-party public API.
* Ability to read Java and Spring Boot code, including project layouts, controllers, DTOs, and annotations, well enough to understand an API contract and debug integration issues.
* API contract fluency, including OpenAPI, Swagger, JSON Schema, HTTP semantics, status codes, error\-payload handling, and versioning.
* Awareness of the common cross\-language failure modes: timezone and date format mismatches, floating\-point versus decimal handling, integer precision, inconsistent null representation.


Good\-to\-Have Skills  

* Exposure to OTT, streaming, broadcast or digital media platforms.
* Familiarity with streaming concepts, including HLS and DASH manifests, DRM technologies such as Widevine, PlayReady, and FairPlay, CDN caching behaviour, SSAI, and entitlement models.
* Ability to write or modify Java/Spring Boot code, not only read it.

* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.

* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


Google Pay is one of the leading UPI apps in India. Our mission is to make payments and commerce simple, fast, and reliable to unlock a brighter financial future for everyone in India. We aim to provide affordable access to financial services across the region. Specifically, Google Pay aims to empower all users with the confidence to participate in the digital economy by making it the simplest, safest, and most trusted financial platform. The overall goal is to reduce transaction friction and enhance everyday financial experiences.


Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

We offer to corporates a unified software cum payments platform for the employee expense, benefits, rewards as well as their vendor payments and channel incentives. We offer a variety of payments instruments including corporate credit cards, purchase cards, virtual cards, Prepaid cards, wearables etc. issued in partnership with leading banks like Kotak Mahindra Bank, ICICI Bank, Yes Bank, SBI Cards, IndusInd Bank amongst others.
 



  





 Our platform solutions are sector\-agnostic, and our network of corporate customers covers the BFSI, Technology, Healthcare, Manufacturing, FMCG, Infrastructure and Automobile industries, among others. Some of our well\-known customers include TATA Steel, Persistent Systems, Toshiba, Inox, Pitney Bowes, Wockhardt, PCBL (RP –Sanjiv Goenka Group) and Greenply Industries to name a few. Visit us at www.zaggle.in to know more about us!
 



  





 We believe “Innovation is the Key” and Zaggle has been instrumental with launching multiple successful products in the last 3 years in the Business Spend Management space. Today we are a 300\+ member strong team spread across Technology, Product, Sales, Implementation Services, Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal and Support functions with 7 office locations in India.
 



  





**About the job** 




 Own the client\-driven P2P roadmap for requests that affect implementation, renewals and existing accounts. Prioritise client requirements, work with engineering to deliver them, and confirm that each release solves the issue raised.
 



 This hands\-on product role works closely with implementation, customer success, support and engineering on an enterprise SaaS platform with contractual timelines.
 



  





**Responsibilities :** 




**Client requests and delivery** 



* Intake, triage and prioritisation of all requests from implementation, onboarding and existing clients.
* The backlog of existing\-client feature requests and enhancement asks — kept current, sized and defensible.
* A working partnership with customer success and support on the pain points blocking renewals or expansion.
* Acceptance criteria for client\-specific and client\-driven requirements, written so QA and engineering can act on them without a follow\-up meeting.
* Scoping and delivery timelines agreed with engineering, and the communication of those timelines to everyone waiting on them.
* SLA tracking for client and implementation commitments, including contract\-tied deadlines.
* Sprint delivery for client requests you own sprint completion rate and the scrum cadence for this track.
* Live issues, bug fixes and the technical debt that surfaces through client interactions.
* Status and timeline communication back to CS, implementation and support, without them having to chase you.
* Escalation of repeated requests upward as candidate roadmap items for the growth track.



**How success is measured** 



* Sprint completion rate on client requests; resolution time and SLA adherence
* Fewer implementation blockers; CSAT and NPS tied to responsiveness
* Churn risk mitigated through resolution of specific product gaps



**To succeed in the role** 




**Qualifications and experience** 



* This one is non\-negotiable: you must come from a P2P product background. The product you own today or owned most recently has to be a procure\-to\-pay product. We are not able to consider strong PMs from adjacent SaaS categories for this role.
* Minimum 3 years in product management, owning a product or module rather than only gathering requirements for one.
* Deep, current knowledge of the P2P industry: who the buyers are, how procurement and finance teams actually work, who you compete with and where each of you is weak.
* You can walk us through your product end to end the workflow, the edge cases, the trade\-offs you chose and why without a deck.
* Experience with enterprise clients, contractual SLAs and requirements that arrive mid\-implementation.
* Comfortable running a sprint with engineering: writing stories, defining acceptance criteria, sizing with the team, holding the cadence.
* Clear written communication. Most of this job is making a decision legible to people who were not in the room.



**P2P skills and know\-how** 



* Intake to procure: catalogue and non\-catalogue requisitions, approval matrices, budget checks, purchase requests, and the politics of an approval chain.
* PO lifecycle: PO creation and amendments, blanket and service POs, partial receipts, GRN, closures.
* Invoice to pay: invoice capture and OCR, two\-way and three\-way matching, exception and mismatch handling, credit and debit notes, payment runs.
* Vendor lifecycle: onboarding and KYC, bank account verification, vendor master data, vendor portals and self\-service.
* Compliance: GST and input credit, TDS, e\-invoicing and IRN, e\-way bill, audit trails and retention.
* Integrations: ERP and accounting sync SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Tally, Zoho through APIs or file\-based flows, and what breaks in the real world.
* Spend visibility: spend controls, budget consumption, and the reporting finance teams ask for after go\-live.



**Helpful experience** 



* Exposure to adjacent spend categories corporate cards, expense management, payables automation.
* Building configurable features on a multi\-tenant SaaS platform, where one client's request cannot become everyone's problem.
* Working fluency with Jira and SQL, enough to answer your own questions about usage and backlog health.
* Fintech or B2B payments experience in the Indian market.

 **AI Product Manager** 
 who can operate at the intersection of product, technology, client engagement, and execution. This is a high\-ownership, enterprise\-facing role for someone who is excited by the opportunity to shape cutting\-edge AI applications, work directly with international clients, and translate complex business problems into scalable AI\-enabled products.
   

  

 The AI Product Manager will lead the definition, shaping, and execution of enterprise AI products and features for global clients. You will work closely with clients, engineering teams, designers, and delivery leaders to identify opportunities, define product direction, manage expectations, and bring AI\-first solutions to life.

**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Product Specialist II**
 An Applied AI Product Specialist II is a mid\-level individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross\-functional product teams to solve customer problems that align with business needs. Being a mid\-level product management role, you will have the opportunity to own products of lesser complexity that drive business value. The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist, like any of our product managers, is accountable for the product’s success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. This role harnesses AI and agentic tools to compress the concept\-to\-cash learning loop—automating analysis, prototyping, and compliance detail\-work so the team can focus on the human judgment AI cannot replace: product sense\-making.
   

  

 The Applied AI Product Specialist II plays a crucial role in ensuring the success of our less complex yet valuable products by balancing customer needs with business objectives. This role requires a blend of strategic vision, analytical skills, and collaborative teamwork to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. It demands some experience in the modern product management craft and a drive for continuous improvement—amplified by the fluent, responsible use of AI to learn faster and earn faster.

+ Drive strategy\-aligned solutions to achieve product value objectives.

+ Measure KPIs and analyze outcomes to inform future strategies.

* Ability to meet deadlines

**Who we are looking for**

An experienced operation manager for the SSGM India COO organization with a proven record of managing processes and large teams in the area of securities lending, mark to market, SBL, Corporate actions, Settlements of FI or Equity and Collateral management.

  

  

**Why this role is important to us**


The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSGM). When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to SSM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world. Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.  

  



**What you will be responsible for**

As Agency Lending \- Collateral \& Settlements \-Assistant Vice President, you will

  

  

**Position Responsibilities**

* Processes high volume of international loans, Recall returns, Equilend \& Non\-Equilend Broker Returns daily adhering to established procedures and controls; monitors and resolves pending and failing aged Returns. Contract Compare, Billing, etc

* Executes instructions to receive or deliver securities from counterparties.
* Ensure that your team meets the agreed SLA, KPI and KRI and evidence of the same documented every day.
* Reviews contract compare records, DDA’s to validate positions with each counterparty.
* Assists business area with inquiries pertaining to transactional activity; coordinates response with traders, corporate actions staff and other internal teams.
* Ensure timely resolution of counterparty issues including pricing problems, quantities of loans and borrows, etc. while keeping management informed of any potential issues.
* Identifies and analyzes operations risks related to current and potential business and recommends procedural changes/improvements as needed

* Works collaboratively across SSGM Globally on key initiatives.

* Demonstrate ‘Risk Excellence’ culture in your behaviour and nurture the same ethos within the team, encouraging an environment of openness and transparency that fuels effective challenge, debate and open discussion.
* Establish and nurture a culture of individual and collective ownership at the ‘captive’ giving all staff a clear sense of both responsibility and accountability. Develop effective working relationships with all SSGM staff at all levels across all locations
* Ensure that all staff adheres to the expected SSGM Code of Conduct.
* In depth knowledge of domains like\- securities lending, mark to market, SBL, Corporate actions, Settlements of FI or Equity and Collateral management.
* Should have 12 years of experience in knowledge services environment serving Capital Market in Stock lending domain, handling a team of over 20 people at a minimum.
* Communicates with other team members from diverse background in an effective manner. Influences and motivates the team. Creates an empowering climate. Projects an inspiring presence and collaborates by fostering a network of communication
* Demonstrates flexibility and effectiveness with changing environments, tasks, responsibilities \& people. Is open to change and new ideas while maintaining core goals and values. Adapts behavior and work methods in response to new information, changes or organization demands
* Ability of an individual to facilitate the continuous development of individual \& organizational competencies, developing other’s potential through the sharing of expertise and providing timely feedback. Continue to coach and mentor staff.
* Track and monitor the workflow queues/day to day workload/pending requests/mailbox to avoid any potential issues and delays and ensure 100% SLA and accuracy and timelines for BAU deliverables.
* Drive opportunities to work across groups in support of client needs, contribute in enhancing operating model and key Business Unit and Transformation initiatives, deliver on business and regulatory initiatives as per set timelines, achieve our financial commitments by providing better client service.
* Always finding better ways to improve the process\-you are responsible to drive and provide process improvement ideas to make the process and operating model better and efficient. Encourage staff to think differently. Look to provide time saves and risk reduction
* Ensure 3 tier back up and bolster resiliency by planning split ops across both locations.
* SSGM COO transformation \- understand and assess internal control environment to drive year\-over\-year improvement and enhancement of internal controls – promote self identification working in partnership with the global SSGM Business Controls teams

jobs.description:
Hi,

Hope you are doing well. My name is Chandrika, and I’m reaching out from Engineering Square — an IT consulting and outsourcing company that helps businesses find the right tech talent quickly.

Please take a look at the job description below. If it looks like a good fit for you, just reply with your updated resume and your expected salary.

Salesforce Tech Lead — Lending, Experience Cloud and Integrations (Offshore)

Delivery leadership · Experience Cloud partner portals · Consumer lending on Salesforce · Salesforce ↔ NetSuite integration · Offshore

ABOUT ENGINEERING SQUARE

Engineering Square LLC is a Fremont, California–based enterprise consulting firm delivering Salesforce, integration, and AI engineering for US enterprise clients. Our engineers embed directly with client teams — their tools, their ceremonies — with E2 engagement management and a named backup behind every seat.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Lead the offshore pod supporting a US solar manufacturer and its consumer\-financing affiliate. This is a full\-time Engineering Square role placed with the client. You own the solution design within the client's architecture across two Salesforce orgs, run code review and release discipline, and act as the pod's day\-to\-day coordination point with the client's delivery leads — daily standups, work tracked on the client's boards, and a modern CI/CD pipeline. The strongest signal we are hiring for is a lead who has shipped an Experience Cloud partner portal end to end, has led delivery on Salesforce in a lending business, and has owned an ERP integration — and who still writes Apex and LWC on the hardest stories.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the design: own the solution design and integration architecture within the client's landscape across both orgs — cross\-org integration, shared partner data, and one\-way data hand\-offs built on custom objects alongside the managed lending package, never inside it

Lead the Experience Cloud portal work: partner and customer sites — self\-registration and onboarding, sharing and guest\-user security, partner user licensing, federated login, LWC and page development; set the portal standards the developers build to

Lead the lending\-platform build: application intake, status visibility, document and e\-signature steps on the origination platform; design the post\-origination processes — funding, disbursement and servicing hand\-off — on custom objects alongside the managed package

Own the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote\-to\-cash integration: the lead backlog item — customer/account, product and pricing sync; opportunity → sales order; invoice and payment status back\-sync; reconciliation of Salesforce, ERP and warehouse data. Own the design, the error handling, retries, idempotency and monitoring

Design partner APIs with monitoring: externally consumed APIs for installer and channel partners, with authentication, versioning, logging, alerting and replay built in from the first release

Run code review and release discipline: lead code reviews; hold the release checklist; enforce unit\-test coverage, PMD static analysis and Confluence design notes and runbooks; nothing ships without QA sign\-off

Mentor the pod: set the pod's engineering standard; mentor the senior developer and the developer; run the E2 round\-1 technical screen for new pod members

Be the coordination point with the client: join the client's daily standup inside the overlap window; report status, risks and the coming week's plan directly to client stakeholders — business, product and platform owners; send the Friday written summary; raise risks early, never late

CONTEXT YOU WILL WORK IN

Two Salesforce orgs. The manufacturer runs a Sales, Service and Experience Cloud org with an installer partner portal (self\-registration, knowledge, support). Its consumer\-financing affiliate runs a separate org on a Salesforce\-native loan and lease origination managed package, with its own installer partner portal (login federated to an external identity provider). Around both sit NetSuite (ERP — the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote\-to\-cash integration is the lead backlog item), Snowflake (financing and credit\-risk analytics), an AWS integration layer (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS) and an integration platform. Work spans both orgs: cross\-org integration, shared partner data, one\-way data hand\-offs alongside the managed package.

MUST\-HAVE SKILLS

Experience Cloud — partner portals: has implemented at least one Experience Cloud partner portal end to end — site build (LWR or Aura), self\-registration and onboarding flow, sharing and guest\-user security, partner user licensing. Candidates who have shipped a partner portal go to the top of the list

Lending domain: Salesforce in financial services or consumer lending — origination lifecycle, borrower and partner (dealer / installer) journeys

Loan\-origination package: hands\-on with a Salesforce\-native loan/lease origination managed package. Q2 Cloud Lending / Symphonix experience strongly preferred

Delivery leadership: has led a delivery team of engineers on at least one client\-facing Salesforce implementation — owned the solution design, ran code review and releases, and was accountable to the client for the outcome; has owned the integration on at least one ERP\-connected implementation

Salesforce core: Apex, LWC, Flows, SOQL, asynchronous Apex, Platform Events; Named Credentials; Salesforce CDC, Bulk and Streaming APIs; hands\-on on the hardest stories

APIs and integrations: REST, GraphQL and SOAP; API design — contracts, versioning, auth, error semantics; an integration platform of the Workato / MuleSoft / Boomi class; AWS Lambda, API Gateway and SQS

NetSuite integration (hands\-on): SuiteTalk (REST/SOAP) or RESTlets; quote\-to\-cash and order\-to\-cash object flows between Salesforce and NetSuite

Snowflake and data reconciliation (hands\-on): Salesforce CDC or batch extraction into Snowflake; reconciling platform data against ERP and finance…

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.


We are evolving our product portfolio across all digital capabilities. As that portfolio grows, we need a Technical Product Manager who can connect business needs to technical delivery, ensuring the products we build are not only strategically aligned, but also practical, measurable, and well\-adopted.


We are looking for a Technical Product Manager who can bridge the gap between business stakeholders and engineering teams. The Technical Product Manager will translate business, operational, and technical requirements into clear product priorities, release plans, and acceptance criteria and will drive the adoption and continuous improvement of the products we deliver.

**What you will do?**


You will work closely with Engineering Managers, Solution Architects, UX/UI Designers, QA, DevOps, business stakeholders, and leadership to shape the product direction and ensure delivery stays aligned to business outcomes.


In practice, that means you will turn strategic intent into a clear product roadmap, define well\-scoped backlog items, and help the team build products that are useful, usable, and measurable.

**Define and prioritise product direction**

* Define and communicate the product vision aligned with business objectives.
* Maintain the product roadmap based on customer needs, market trends, and strategic priorities.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
* Evaluate market trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies to guide product direction.
 **Translate needs into delivery\-ready plans**

* Gather and analyse business requirements from customers and stakeholders.
* Translate business needs into clear features, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Define product goals, success metrics, and release objectives.
* Prioritise the backlog using business value, customer impact, and technical feasibility.
* Balance short\-term delivery with long\-term product strategy.
 **Own delivery and adoption**

* Own and manage the product backlog.
* Work closely with cross functional delivery teams to ensure requirements are clearly understood.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with Product owners, Delivery leads, Engineering Managers and Solution Architects to plan releases.
* Support user acceptance testing, production readiness, and post\-release adoption.
**Product analytics**

* Define and monitor key performance indicators.
* Analyse product performance using customer feedback, usage metrics, and business data.
* Make data\-driven decisions for future enhancements.
* Track feature adoption, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.
**Collaborate across functions**

* Build strong relationships with customers, business leaders, and cross\-functional teams.
* Gather feedback through interviews, workshops, and product usage insights.
* Communicate product vision, roadmap, and release plans to stakeholders.
* Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, UX/UI, QA, DevOps, Cloud Infra, Marketing product teams, mobile app teams, program managers, business, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership.
* Ensure alignment across teams throughout the product lifecycle.
 **What you bring?**

**Experience and Preferred Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, or Product Owner.
* Experience with customer\-facing mobile applications is preferred.
* Minimum 3 years of experience managing digital or software products.
* Experience working with Agile software development teams.
* Experience engaging multiple stakeholders, facilitating requirements sessions, and turning ambiguity into clear priorities.
* Experience working in a medical device, hearing aid, or regulated healthcare product environment.
* Professional certifications such as CSPO, PSPO, SAFe Product Manager/Product Owner, or Pragmatic Institute certifications.
 **Technical skills**

* Product roadmap planning and product lifecycle management
* Release planning, product discovery, and requirements management
* Microsoft Azure fundamentals
* Working knowledge of AI\-assisted product discovery and documentation tools
 **Personal competencies**

* You are a natural connector, you build trust with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and keep them aligned.
* You are precise with definitions. You know that unclear requirements create avoidable product risk.
* You are thorough in documentation. You treat roadmaps, specifications, and acceptance criteria as deliverables.
* You advocate for the customer and the business, you think about how the product will be used and how it creates value.
* You manage ambiguity well. You can take a loosely defined problem and turn it into a structured, actionable plan.
 **Education**

* University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Administration, Product Management, or related disciplines.

Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

 Anaqua is expanding its development capability in Hyderabad to support and accelerate the evolution of the RightHub platform. We are looking for a strong, delivery\-focused Product Owner to work locally with the Hyderabad engineering team and act as the day\-to\-day product partner for development squads building and enhancing the RightHub platform.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who can bridge product strategy and engineering execution. The Product Owner will translate product direction, customer needs, roadmap priorities, and platform requirements into clear, actionable backlog items for the engineering team. They will work closely with global Product Managers and Product Leadership to ensure the Hyderabad team understands not only what needs to be built, but why it matters.

More important is the ability to learn a complex domain, communicate clearly, manage detail, and help engineering teams deliver high\-quality software. Proficiency in AI automation using agents is a big plus.

jobs.description:
Takes a fully independent lead in several areas of product development by following the principles of Agile to manage the team backlog, anticipate and prioritize needs, oversee development stages, act as a primary liaison and evaluate product progress. Serves as the customer proxy; works collaboratively with business owners and other stakeholders to accomplish these tasks with little to no support with a high volume of work and increased complexity. Utilizes strong understanding of the business vision to to regularly contribute and manage execution. Heavily influences the business owner's requirements, the Product Manager's program vision and roadmap while introducing new and useful tools and practices to drive continuous improvement. Provides overall leadership to Product Owner team through mentorship and guidance and provides back up to Product Manager, as needed.
   

  

**Essential Job Functions**
 Applies basic scientific practice within iterations in order to routinely plan, do, check and adjust. Manages team backlog items and prioritizes based on business value. Outlines dependencies and informs stakeholders the necessary sequence of development to ensure optimized performance and outcomes. Holds a significant role in quality control and is the primary team member empowered to accept stories as done. Utilizes advanced business knowledge, based on prior experience within business function, and communication skills to anticipate problems and address them accordingly. Works cross functionally in a self\-organizing manner to accomplish tasks and effectively manage the backlog. Leads processes and procedure changes identified by teams by working with external business partners. Effectively applies critical thinking to identify flexibility in determining how and when each iteration and product element will be developed. Acts as primary communicator and connection between stakeholders, end users and teams determining if each story meets their shared e xpectations. Ensures collaboration from all stakeholders on decisions and strategy providing clear instructions and deliverables for developers. Takes ownership for each stage of the process and final product to ensure the goal and vision are correctly aligned with the work items on the backlog. Contributes strategic input into the prioritization of the program backlog, coordinates dependencies and manages the inspection and evaluation of product progress through each iteration. Drives the mitigation of program risks. Leads PO and/or ART sync meetings in addition to the system demo to show critical aspects of the solution. Leads in Inspect \& Adapt (I\&A) workshop to work across teams to define and implement improvement stories to increase program quality. A key member of the Agile team who utilizes perspective to define iteration goals and drives execution and delivery. Partners with the business owner to understand needs, manage scope and add/eliminate user stories while contributing heavy influence to build an effective strategy. Communicates requirements to Agile Team in a clear and collaborative manner to determine new requirements, negotiate teams and dependencies. Regularly interacts closely with the Product Manager in order to discuss goals and vision of the business/value stream, sharing extensive knowledge in order to make sound decisions. Heavily involved in the Program Increment (PI) planning, story definition and assists team with story estimates and sequencing. Oversees the development of the product to include planning, refinement, review, and execution. Partners with stakeholders to identify and organize steps required for next iteration. Works to gain clarity on queries and participate in the demo of committed items. Participates in ceremonies within the team to coordinate efforts with team to refine the process, identify areas for improvement and support the execution of tasks. Continuously keeps the end\-user needs in mind based on higher level of business acumen to ensure the solution meets expectations and the development delivers expected outcomes from the accepted stories. Independently represents business owners' interest and prioritize user stories based on business value while maximizing agile team's capacity. Provides mentorship and guidance to PO I and II. Performs other duties as assigned.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Guidewire Policy Center (cloud instance) \- Intermediate (4\-6 Years)
   

  

 Rally (or other equivalent work management tool) \- Intermediate (4\-6 Years)
   

  

 Office Suite \- Intermediate (4\-6 Years)
   

  

 Copilot or other AI tools \- Intermediate (4\-6 Years)
   

  

**Benefits**
 Competitive compensation and benefits package:
   

  

* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office\-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
* Private Health Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development


 Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.
   

  

**About Capgemini**
 Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 55\-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22\.5 billion in revenues in 2023\.

jobs.title: Product Lead Data Management Services
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Product Lead Data Management Services**
 HSBC Data \& Analytics Office (DAO) promotes a data\-driven culture across HSBC through our strategy of:
   

  

* Protect: To protect our data we need robust policies for data management and enhanced governance e.g. data that is consumed from a trusted source, meets quality standards, and complies with regulatory obligations.
* Connect: Move to a data\-led culture through enhanced training including on the job opportunities. Our talent is the glue between protecting our data and unlocking value for our customers.
* Unlock. Value is unlocked when we deliver on the opportunities our well\-managed data presents e.g. improving customer / colleague experience, increasing revenue, commercialising our data, optimising capital, enhancing risk management or reducing costs.


 We are hiring a Product Lead \- DMS within Data Management Services (part of Data \& Analytics Office)
   

  

 The Data function owns the bank’s data controls and the ecosystem of tools that allows every business and function to implement and evidence those controls. That ecosystem is being rebuilt: legacy tools are being redesigned, new platforms are being brought in, and the target state is a fully automated, control\-by\-design data estate, where data quality, lineage, metadata, classification, retention, access and issue management are largely machine\-executed rather than manually attested.
   

  

 We are hiring a Product Lead to own that estate end to end. This is a build\-and\-scale mandate on a compressed timeline, not a steady\-state product management role. The successful candidate will set the product strategy, consolidate a fragmented tooling landscape into a coherent platform, lead the product community, and be personally accountable for landing the target state within an aggressive delivery window.
   

  

**Governance and Committee Memberships**
* The jobholder will continually reassess the operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology.
* The jobholder will also adhere to and be able to demonstrate adherence to internal controls. This will be achieved by adherence to all relevant procedures, keeping appropriate records and, where appropriate, by the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, including issues raised by external regulators.
* The jobholder will implement the Group compliance policy by containing compliance risk in liaison with Global Head of Compliance, Global Compliance Officer, Area Compliance Officer or Local Compliance Officer. The term ‘compliance’ embraces all relevant financial services laws, rules and codes with which the business has to comply


**In This Role, You Will**
* Own the DMS product vision and multi\-year roadmap to deliver the bank\-wide automated data control journey (control\-by\-design, scalable and measurable). Convert control outcomes into deliverable increments (epics/features) with clear acceptance criteria and benefits tracking (e.g., automation rate, evidence quality, adoption, cycle\-time reduction).
* Partner with Data Technology and Architecture to define the target state and make explicit buy / build / configure / retire decisions, including legacy rationalisation and decommissioning. Create platform consistency by setting common product standards/patterns across DMS (e.g., workflow, APIs, integration patterns, MI/metrics, auditability) so tools operate as one coherent estate.
* Lead and develop the Product Owner community across the DMS portfolio, setting direction, ways of working and a consistent bar for discovery, prioritisation and outcome delivery. jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Nextpower is seeking a Senior Supply Chain Analyst to lead the configuration, maintenance, enhancement and day\-to\-day support of supply chain and transportation technology. The role combines deep supply chain and transportation domain knowledge with hands\-on expertise across Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM), supplier\-facing applications, Anaplan and FourKites track and trace. The successful candidate will translate business needs into reliable system solutions, improve operational visibility and help ensure continuity across planning, execution, trade compliance and supplier collaboration.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own functional support and continuous improvement for OTM and GTM, including issue triage, root\-cause analysis, configuration changes, testing and production support.
* Configure and maintain OTM processes for order management, shipment planning, rate and contract management, tendering, carrier collaboration, freight settlement, tracking and execution workflows.
* Configure and support GTM capabilities including product classification, country of origin, duty and tariff determination, landed cost, restricted party screening, sanctions and trade compliance controls.
* Support integrations and data flows between OTM, GTM, ERP, WMS, supplier portal, Anaplan, FourKites and other custom applications. Validate interfaces, monitor failures and coordinate defect resolution.
* Partner with sourcing, logistics, transportation, finance, trade compliance, suppliers and freight forwarders to document requirements and convert them into scalable system solutions.
* Manage changes across development, test and production environments, including release planning, regression testing, UAT support, deployment coordination and post\-release validation.
* Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, alerts and operational metrics that improve shipment visibility, supplier performance, freight cost control and exception management.
* Create clear functional specifications, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, operating procedures and user training materials.
* Identify opportunities to simplify manual work, improve data quality, strengthen controls and use system capabilities to support business growth.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Transportation, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related field.
* 5\-8 years of experience in supply chain, transportation, logistics technology or related operations, with significant experience supporting enterprise supply chain applications.
* Deep hands\-on experience configuring, maintaining and supporting Oracle Transportation Management and Oracle Global Trade Management in a production environment.
* Strong understanding of transportation planning and execution, carrier and freight forwarder operations, tendering, rate management, freight settlement, shipment visibility and trade compliance.
* Practical experience with supplier portals or supplier collaboration applications, Anaplan planning models and FourKites or comparable track and trace platforms.
* Experience with requirements analysis, configuration, test management, UAT, incident/change management and production support.
* Working knowledge of Oracle databases and SQL. Familiarity with OTM/GTM integrations, XML, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware or ERP/WMS interfaces.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication and stakeholder\-management skills. Able to work independently and collaborate across business and technology teams.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with OTM/GTM Cloud implementations, upgrades, patches, environment migrations or large\-scale enhancement programs.
* Knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud, ERP, WMS, S\&OP or supply planning processes.
* Experience supporting global trade programs involving tariff classification, duty and tax analysis, sanctions screening, RPLS/denied\-party screening and audit controls.
* Oracle certification in OTM, GTM or Supply Chain applications.

**SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE**

Success will be measured by stable and responsive application support, accurate and compliant transportation and trade processes, faster resolution of operational exceptions, improved data and integration quality, and measurable adoption of system capabilities across supply chain teams.


At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility\-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data\-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.


**We are Nextpower**

Brightstar Hospitality is an award\-winning hotel management company operating a growing portfolio on behalf of a range of owners, supported by a central finance function based at our head office. Our motto is people – quality – profit, and it is no accident that people come first. * Analyse trading performance across the portfolio, including occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, segmentation, channel mix, length of stay and booking curve, and support rate, demand, competitor and market analysis for revenue meetings.

* Co\-own the group’s data and AI governance framework with the Finance Director, covering ownership, definitions, access, retention and change control, ensuring personal data is handled in line with UK GDPR, access is segregated appropriately between properties, entities and owners, and card and payment data is excluded from analytical environments in line with PCI DSS.

**Description**
 Customer experience is at the heart of all we do at Amazon, as we strive to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Amazon Customer Service (CS) is at the forefront of customer experience, working relentlessly to provide customers a convenient, high quality, and delightful experience — across all of our CS channels — in every interaction.
   

  

 Within CS, Network Solutions is responsible for designing, planning, and operating the world's largest customer service network — building intelligent, adaptive systems that anticipate demand, match customers to optimal experiences, and continuously improve service quality. We are transforming CS from a manually operated, reactive model into an AI\-native ecosystem that makes CS a growth driver and competitive advantage for Amazon.
   

  

 We are seeking a Business Analyst to join the Network Control Center (NCC), Amazon's central incident management function for Customer Service. The NCC detects, manages, and resolves high\-severity incidents impacting customers, associates, drivers, and brands in real time — coordinating response across dozens of teams to minimize customer impact and restore service. When systems fail at scale, contact volumes spike unexpectedly, or a service disruption threatens millions of customer interactions, the NCC takes command. You will be responsible to be the single source of truth in terms of data and analysis during and after incidents, and ensure metrics at leadership level is reported accurately.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Real\-Time Incident Analytics — Serve as the single source of truth for data and analysis during high\-severity incidents, providing actionable insights to guide response decisions and minimize customer impact.
* Post\-Incident Reporting \& Metrics — Deliver accurate, leadership\-level metrics and post\-incident analysis, ensuring root causes, impact scope, and resolution timelines are clearly documented.
* Cross\-Functional Data Coordination — Partner with dozens of response teams during incidents to aggregate, validate, and synthesize data from multiple systems, enabling a unified operational picture.
* Trend Identification \& Proactive Insights — Analyze incident patterns, contact volume spikes, and service disruption data to identify recurring issues and recommend preventive measures that reduce future customer impact.

* 2\+ years of complex Excel VBA macros writing experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights

jobs.description:
**About OnArrival** 




 OnArrival is a travel technology company enabling banks, fintechs, and consumer platforms to offer seamless travel experiences through our technology infrastructure.
 



 We are looking for a Product Manager to lead our Flights vertical and build reliable, scalable, and customer\-focused products. We want someone who is deeply comfortable using AI as part of everyday product work, not simply adding “AI\-powered” features to a roadmap.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Own the Flights product roadmap from discovery through execution.
* Improve search, booking, payments, and post\-booking experiences.
* Work closely with engineering, design, business, operations, and external partners.
* Use customer feedback, market insights, and product data to identify opportunities.
* Define requirements, prioritise initiatives, and drive products from concept to launch.
* Improve conversion, reliability, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
* Build scalable capabilities that can serve multiple enterprise customers.
* Track product performance and continuously improve key journeys.



  





**How We Expect You to Use AI** 




 At OnArrival, AI is part of how we work, think, and build. The ideal candidate should use AI meaningfully across the product lifecycle.
 



 You will be expected to:
 


* Use AI tools for research, competitive analysis, product discovery, and synthesising customer feedback.
* Analyse large volumes of support conversations, operational issues, and user behaviour to uncover patterns and opportunities.
* Create product specifications, user flows, edge\-case matrices, prototypes, and test scenarios faster and with greater depth.
* Use AI\-assisted prototyping and coding tools to validate ideas before committing significant engineering effort.
* Work with data and engineering teams to query, interpret, and visualise product data.
* Evaluate where AI can genuinely simplify customer journeys, reduce manual work, or improve decision\-making.
* Understand the practical strengths and limitations of LLMs, including hallucinations, latency, cost, privacy, evaluation, and human oversight.
* Define clear success metrics and evaluation frameworks for AI\-enabled product experiences.
* Think beyond chat interfaces and identify opportunities for intelligent recommendations, automation, personalisation, and agent\-led actions.
* Continuously experiment with new AI tools and help improve how the wider product organisation operates.



  





 You do not need to be an ML engineer. However, you should be technically curious, comfortable experimenting independently, and capable of working closely with engineering teams to turn AI possibilities into reliable products.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 3–5 years of product management experience.
* Prior experience in flights, airlines, OTAs, travel technology, or a closely related domain.
* Strong understanding of flight search, booking, ticketing, and post\-booking journeys.
* Experience working with airline, GDS, NDC, or travel\-supplier integrations.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and product execution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with engineering and understand API\-based products.
* Hands\-on experience using modern AI tools in day\-to\-day product work.
* Ability to distinguish meaningful AI applications from features driven purely by hype.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong ownership and comfort working through ambiguity.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience building B2B, B2B2C, embedded, or platform products.
* Exposure to payments, refunds, reconciliation, or travel operations.
* Experience with SQL, analytics platforms, experimentation, or rapid prototyping.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs, AI agents, prompt design, retrieval systems, or AI product evaluation.
* Experience launching an AI\-enabled customer or internal product.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Own a critical product vertical with significant business impact.
* Solve complex problems across travel, technology, commerce, and AI.
* Build products used by leading consumer platforms and their customers.
* Work closely with the founders and a strong cross\-functional team.
* Operate in a culture where product managers are expected to think, prototype, analyse, and execute.
* Help shape the next generation of embedded and intelligent travel experiences.
* If you understand flights deeply, think clearly about products, and already use AI to work faster and better, we would love to hear from you.

**Description**
 Join Amazon Health Services' One Medical team and shape the systems that determine how customer generated health data and third party health data drive better health outcomes for patients. You will define product strategy and drive execution for the platforms that ingest, normalize, and surface health data from diverse sources — wearables, connected devices, lab integrations, and patient reported inputs — turning fragmented signals into actionable clinical and consumer insights. These systems power experiences across the care continuum: enabling providers to make more informed decisions, helping patients engage meaningfully with their own health, and unlocking data driven personalization across Amazon Health Services.
   

  

 Health data is unlike typical consumer data: it is governed by HIPAA and evolving state level privacy regulations, arrives in inconsistent formats (HL7, FHIR, proprietary device APIs), carries clinical significance that demands accuracy, and requires careful consent and access controls. Every product decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager \- Tech to own the product strategy for how One Medical ingests, reconciles, and leverages customer generated and third party health data to improve care delivery and patient outcomes. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across data ingestion pipelines, health record enrichment, data quality and normalization, and surfacing insights to clinicians and patients — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying data platforms and ML systems.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Define the product vision and multi year roadmap for customer generated health data systems: data ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and clinical surfacing
   

  

 Translate complex health data and regulatory constraints (HIPAA, FHIR/HL7 interoperability, consent management, state privacy laws) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against
   

  

 Design and own the end to end metrics framework for data quality, completeness, and clinical utility within your domain
   

  

 Work with Clinical Operations, Provider Experience, Compliance, Privacy, and Platform Engineering partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
   

  

 Partner with Applied Scientists and Engineers to define success criteria for data reconciliation models, insight generation algorithms, and automated triage systems
   

  

 Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in healthcare
* Experience with ML/AI product management — defining success criteria for models, managing model lifecycle, A/B testing ML systems

+ Work with project team to prioritize requirements and agree on assumptions and constraints.
+ Organize, model, and specify requirements with the appropriate level of detail given complexity, risk, and audience.
+ Work with project team to verify and validate requirements through review of requirements.
